selection_criteria: All retained original cases of an independently source-reviewed requirement are certified against the current explicit model.
Fresh source-only oracle agrees with original label; every negative has an independently source/schema-valid intended-only counterfactual.
A source-reviewed finite represented-core branch/obligation matrix is witnessed. Listed robustness limits remain explicit.
No workflow verdict, score, SHACL text, violation report or generation eligibility is a selection criterion.
scope_warning: Conservative reviewed mini-core, not a maximal or representative reduced benchmark. Other requirements are deferred for evidence, not performance. Already inspected cases are development/regression evidence, not pristine held-out data.
